_comment: Committed build input for site/_gen.py. The site builds without disc data, so these cannot be computed at deploy time. Refresh locally with scripts/ci/update-progress-metrics.py and commit.

tracks.label: Ghidra tracing
tracks.headline: 100.0% of SCUS_942.54's code
tracks.detail: Share of the main executable's code bytes that sit inside a Ghidra-dumped function. Overlay images are excluded - they alias in address space, so address attribution alone cannot support a figure.

tracks.label: Asset formats
tracks.headline: 100.0% of PROT.DAT content
tracks.detail: Share of disc asset bytes whose container resolves to a documented format. This is format *recognition*, not a byte-for-byte parse, so read it as an upper bound. 0.0% remains unexplained. 266 entries (544,768 bytes) of reserved dev filler are excluded from the denominator: each is a documented one-sector placeholder with nothing in it to parse.

tracks.label: Engine port
tracks.headline: 1043 functions ported
tracks.detail: Of the retail functions identified as port sites, the share carrying a from-scratch Rust implementation. 7 remain on the worklist. Measured against what the project has identified, not against the whole game.

tracks.label: Port wiring
tracks.headline: 969 of 969 ported functions reachable
tracks.detail: A ported function still needs a host that calls it. This is the share reachable from a real entry point; every port a host is owed for is reached. 74 further ports are excluded from the denominator entirely: the engine does their job by construction (CD DMA, memory-card device I/O, MDEC channel sync, GPU packet queues), so no host will ever call them and each says which mechanism replaced it.
tracks.denominator: ported functions a host is owed for

verification.label: Retail kernel differential
verification.headline: 765 of 1043 ported routines run against retail's bytes
verification.detail: Of the retail addresses a PORT tag names, the share a retail kernel differential runs: the routine executes off the user's disc in an R3000 interpreter beside the Rust kernel, on generated inputs, and the regions both wrote must match. Each test declares the routines it runs and fails unless the run entered exactly those bytes. 554 tests run 783 retail routines in all; the rest are setup calls or helpers with no tag of their own. Counted from the declarations, so it needs no disc.
